title: feature_list
description: Per-epic anti-drift contract. JSON (models corrupt it less than Markdown). It is the SINGLE source of truth for whether an epic is done — the agent never judges its own global termination; this file does. HARD PROHIBITION: it is unacceptable to remove or edit a feature's steps/expected, or to add/delete features to make a build look complete. The ONLY permitted mutation is flipping a feature's `passes` from false to true, and only after that feature's `steps` were driven end-to-end (like a user) and produced `expected`.

epic.description: epic id this list belongs to

contract.const: It is unacceptable to remove or edit tests/steps or to add/delete features. Only flip `passes` to true after a real end-to-end pass.

acceptanceCriteria.description: PM-lens checkable statements of intent for this epic. The acceptance stage and the judge pm lens assert these.

statement.description: a single, verifiable statement of required behavior/value

automated.description: true if checked by an assertion/test; false if judge-evaluated

testLevels.description: which test levels this epic's DoD requires; all required levels must be green (never weakened).

epicTests.description: test files/globs authored FOR this epic (test-first during planning) that must pass as part of the DoD

designRefs.description: paths/URLs to design intent (screenshots, Figma) the judge design lens compares the built UI against

steps.description: user-level E2E actions to perform in a real browser/session — NOT unit-test names

expected.description: observable outcome that proves the feature works

passes.description: starts false; flip to true ONLY after driving `steps` and observing `expected`

blindspots.description: known-invisible surfaces (e.g. native OS modals the browser tool cannot see) — flagged in the digest, never silently passed
